v2.subtitle: Advanced search is a small query language. Use field tokens and operators to narrow packs.

basics.title: Basics (how queries are parsed)
basics.intro: Write conditions as field:value or field=value. Use commas for AND inside a group, and | to create OR groups.

examples.or:
name=My Pack | name:cool pack
Either group can match (OR).

fields.title: Pack fields
fields.intro: These fields match pack data. Use : for partial match and = for exact match.

examples.pinned:
owner:teo_72, pinned:true | owner:v0w4n
Combine AND and OR groups.

viewModes.title: View modes
viewModes.intro: Pack visibility modes control who can see a pack. Search with viewMode:0 or viewMode=0.

examples.public: viewMode=0 — Public: everyone can see and search for this pack.
examples.linkOnly: viewMode=1 — Link only: visible with a direct link, not in search results.
examples.private: viewMode=2 — Private: only the owner can see this pack.

tips.title: Tips
tips.intro: A few details that help avoid surprises.

bullets.caseInsensitive: Search is case-insensitive: 'PACK' and 'pack' behave the same.
bullets.partial: Colon (:) allows partial matches: name:cool matches My Cool Pack.
bullets.spacesAllowed: Spaces are allowed in values: name:my cool pack works.
bullets.orderDoesNotMatter: Order does not matter within a group.
bullets.boolean: Boolean values like pinned:true or pinned:false work for true/false fields.
bullets.groupingMentalModel: Think of it as (A AND B) OR (C AND D): commas build AND groups, | splits OR groups.

operatorColon.title: Partial match
operatorColon.desc: Use : to match partial text (example: name:cool).

operatorEquals.title: Exact match
operatorEquals.desc: Use = to match exactly (example: name=My Cool Pack).

operatorComma.title: AND inside a group
operatorComma.desc: Separate terms with commas to require all conditions in the group.

operatorPipe.title: OR between groups
operatorPipe.desc: Use | to split your query into OR groups. If any group matches, the pack is included.

operatorNot.title: NOT (exclude)
operatorNot.desc: Prefix a term with \! to exclude matches containing that term.

id.title: Pack id
id.desc: Exact pack id or public code (example: id=123).

name.title: Name
name.desc: Matches the pack name (example: name:my pack).

owner.title: Owner
owner.desc: Matches the pack owner username (example: owner:v0w4n).

levelId.title: Contained level
levelId.desc: Finds packs that contain this level id (example: levelId=456).

viewMode.title: View mode
viewMode.desc: Pack visibility: 0 public, 1 link only, 2 private, 3 forced private.
